description: Generate a Higgsfield image from a prompt. Prefers the customer's connected Higgsfield MCP account login and subscription credits; api_key is only the Cloud API fallback.

api_key.description: Optional Higgsfield Cloud API key for this call. Omit it to use the connected Higgsfield MCP account login when available.

model.description: Optional Higgsfield model id, e.g. nano_banana_pro

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid in the image

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate

style.description: Style name (use higgsfield_get_styles to list available styles)

name: higgsfield_generate_image
